Package info.openrocket.core.simulation

Class SimulationStatus

java.lang.Object
info.openrocket.core.simulation.SimulationStatus
All Implemented Interfaces:
info.openrocket.core.util.Monitorable, Cloneable
public class SimulationStatus extends Object implements Cloneable, info.openrocket.core.util.Monitorable
A holder class for the dynamic status during the rocket's flight.

  • Constructor Details

    • SimulationStatus

      public SimulationStatus(info.openrocket.core.rocketcomponent.FlightConfiguration configuration, SimulationConditions simulationConditions)

    • SimulationStatus

      public SimulationStatus(SimulationStatus orig)
      Performs a deep copy of the on SimulationStatus object. Most included object are deep-cloned, except for the flight data object (which is shallow copied) and the WarningSet (which is initialized to a new WarningSet). The intention of this constructor is to be used for conversion from one type of SimulationStatus to another, or when simulating multiple stages. When used for simulating multiple stages, a new FlightDataBranch object needs to be associated with the new object.
      Parameters:
      orig - the object from which to copy

  • Method Details

    • copySimStatParameters

      public void copySimStatParameters(SimulationStatus orig)
      Copies selected simulation status data from the specified SimulationStatus object to this instance. This method performs deep cloning for most fields, such as simulation conditions and configuration, but performs shallow copying for others, like the flight data branch. The warnings set is initialized as a new instance rather than cloned. The method also transfers and updates collections and maps, such as recovery devices, motor states, and extra data.
      Parameters:
      orig - the SimulationStatus object from which to copy data

    • clone

      public SimulationStatus clone()
      Returns a copy of this object. The general purpose is that the conditions, rocket configuration, flight data etc. point to the same objects. However, subclasses are allowed to deep-clone specific objects, such as those pertaining to the current orientation of the rocket. The purpose is to allow creating intermediate copies of this object used during step computation.
      Overrides:
      clone in class Object

    • recordWarnings

      boolean recordWarnings()
      Determine whether (most) flight event warnings are currently being saved. Warnings are not saved until 0.25 seconds after leaving the rail, and again after Z velocity is reduced to 20% of the max.
